after: No se pudo iniciar la carga retroactiva desde el historial de búsqueda.
before: No se pudo activar el reabastecimiento del historial de búsqueda
rationale: “Reabastecimiento” suggests restocking and misstates a data backfill. “Carga retroactiva” names the operation more clearly.

rationale: 백업 광고 means “backup ad,” changing the feature meaning. 백필 preserves the software backfill concept used by the caller.

after: Không thể bắt đầu bổ sung dữ liệu từ lịch sử tìm kiếm.
before: Không thể kích hoạt chèn lấp từ lịch sử tìm kiếm
rationale: “Chèn lấp” is unnatural for this data operation. “Bổ sung dữ liệu” clearly describes adding historical data.

after: Die Affinitäten der Mitglieder konnten nicht aktualisiert werden: {error}
rationale: “Mitgliederzuordnungen” means member assignments or mappings and changes the source concept. Both proposals restore the affinity meaning; the blind wording “Die Affinitäten der Mitglieder” is clearer to general readers than the primary compound “Mitgliederaffinitäten.”

after: 無法更新 Pod 探索資訊。
before: 無法更新 Pod 發現信息。
rationale: Current “發現信息” is stiff and uses 信息 where Traditional Chinese UI copy normally uses 資訊. “探索資訊” is more natural for Pod discovery in this context.
